_comment: S4 AREAS ingest scope for the Unofficial Baldur's Gate 3+ Universe Seed. Pulls Sword Coast / Baldur's Gate area + location pages into clean JSON records under content/worlds/<world_id>/areas/<slug>.json, which WorldOS's seed_world loads as NAVIGABLE Locations (places the party can travel to) — not just lookup_lore entries. TEXT/DATA ONLY — no maps/images are fetched or committed. Like manifest_characters.json, areas span TWO wikis with DIFFERENT licenses, so each source carries its own wiki host, MediaWiki script_path, license, and attribution string. cache_subdir 'areas' isolates this pipeline's cache from lore + characters. A title/category that doesn't resolve is skipped, not fatal. BOUNDED at max_pages 80. NOTE: this manifest drives the LATER live fetch; this change ships the PARSER + a hand-written example only (no network run).

sources._comment: bg3.wiki is a STANDALONE MediaWiki (1.43.x), NOT Fandom. Its API lives at /w/api.php (scriptpath '/w'), pretty URLs at /wiki/$1. License per https://bg3.wiki/wiki/bg3wiki:Copyrights — content on/after 2024-07-20 is dual-licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 AND CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; older content is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 only (NonCommercial). WorldOS is a non-commercial fan project, so both options are satisfied; we attribute with a back-link per the wiki's stated requirement, and carry the NonCommercial caveat. Areas here are BG3's in-game zones (the explorable acts/regions).

sources._comment: forgottenrealms.fandom.com is a Fandom wiki (CC-BY-SA, per https://www.fandom.com/licensing). API at /api.php (scriptpath ''). Used for the wider Sword Coast geography whose canon predates BG3 (Candlekeep, Elturel, the Western Heartlands) and for deeper background on the in-game zones; bg3.wiki is preferred for the BG3-specific act regions.
